scenario.summary: A user seeking AI assistance was targeted by a ClickFix social engineering attack that induced them to execute a malicious shell command via Terminal. This command stole a Microsoft 365 session cookie, enabling the attacker to bypass MFA, gain unauthorized inbox access, and perform mailbox manipulation to redirect invoice payments in a Business Email Compromise (BEC) scenario.

hunt.name: ClickFix Shell Execution and Cookie Theft
hunt.description: This hunt targets the initial endpoint stages of a ClickFix-style attack on macOS. It lead with a scoping query to identify hosts running shell interpreters with curl and base64 encoding. It then corroborates these leads by identifying rare command strings and unauthorized access to browser cookie databases, including Safari and Chromium-based paths, specifically on the suspect hosts. An agent weighs the combined evidence to identify successful session theft, ensuring that the file exfiltration occurred after the suspicious command execution.

nodes.label: Shell interpreters running curl and base64

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%/sh' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%/bash' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%/zsh') AND LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%curl%' AND LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%base64%' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify hosts running the specific ClickFix pattern of shell interpreters executing curl with base64 payloads to serve as the suspect list for the hunt.
config.expected_signal: Hosts running encoded curl commands in Terminal. If zero rows are returned, no hosts are currently suspected of this ClickFix variant.

primitive_config.label: Shell interpreters running curl and base64
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%/sh' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%/bash' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%/zsh') AND LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%curl%' AND LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%base64%' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Hosts running encoded curl commands in Terminal. If zero rows are returned, no hosts are currently suspected of this ClickFix variant.

config.content: SELECT LOWER(process_cmd_line) AS cmd, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%/sh' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%/bash' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%/zsh') AND LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%base64%' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) GROUP BY LOWER(process_cmd_line) HAVING host_count <= 3 ORDER BY host_count ASC
config.description: Identify unique shell payloads across suspect hosts to separate targeted ClickFix attacks from standard administrative activity.
config.expected_signal: Specific payload strings seen only on one or two suspected hosts.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, file_path, activity_name, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE (instr(LOWER(file_path), 'library/application support/google/chrome/') > 0 OR instr(LOWER(file_path), 'library/application support/microsoft edge/') > 0 OR instr(LOWER(file_path), 'library/cookies/') > 0 OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%cookies.binarycookies%') AND (LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%cookies%' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%login data%' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%cookies.binarycookies%') AND (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%sh' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%bash' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%zsh' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%curl') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0)
config.description: Identify when shell interpreters or curl access browser cookie storage files on suspect hosts, indicating successful theft.
config.expected_signal: A shell or curl process reading a cookie database for Chrome, Edge, or Safari.
